declaration_1: Only disaster-related news is allowed to appear in the News section.
declaration_2: No additional external news API/provider was introduced.

existing_news_source_preserved.official_fallback: Built-in curated disaster bulletins (IMD, NDMA, GSI, CWC, ASDMA, etc.)
existing_news_source_preserved.details: Existing NewsAPI configuration, endpoints (/api/news, /api/news/refresh), rate limits, error fallbacks, and provider logic remain 100% intact without replacement or duplication.

filtering_approach.strategy: Two-tier deterministic classification and filtering pipeline
filtering_approach.backend_ingestion: src/services/newsService.js filters out non-disaster stories prior to persistence in Mongo, tagging valid articles with normalized disasterCategory and disasterType.
filtering_approach.client_rendering: frontend/src/pages/News.jsx applies filterAndPrioritizeDisasterArticles to memoized article state before rendering feeds, ensuring client-side resilience regardless of feed source.
filtering_approach.no_extra_fetches: Articles are filtered directly in-memory from fetched/cached payloads; zero extra network or provider requests are made.

metaphorical_rejections: landslide victory / landslide win / landslide majority
flood of criticism / complaints / inquiries / applications / messages / tributes
earthquake in the music industry / bollywood / politics
avalanche of new products / orders / lawsuits / requests
unrelated_topic_filtering: Cricket and competitive sports (IPL, BCCI, FIFA, wickets, tournaments)
Smartphones and consumer technology launches (iPhone, Galaxy, Android, chips)
Stock markets, financial indices, quarterly profits (Sensex, Nifty, Nasdaq, IPO)
Celebrity and entertainment news (Bollywood, Hollywood, movie releases, box office)
Political campaign rallies, seat sharing, vote bank controversies
false_positive_protection.fail_safe: Articles mentioning unrelated topics are strictly rejected unless they contain unequivocal physical disaster indicators (such as death toll, rescue operations, submergence, Richter magnitude).

target_regions: Northeast India / NER / Brahmaputra / Barak / Subansiri
ner_prioritization_behavior.sorting_logic: Genuinely relevant disaster articles situated in Northeast India are prioritized and placed at the top of the feed, followed by major India-wide and global disaster events. No genuine disaster is hidden.

api_call_impact.provider_call_frequency: Preserved 1-hour throttle window and rate-limit guardrails

caching_deduplication_preservation.caching: Preserved 1-hour memory cache TTL on server and existing DB persistence
caching_deduplication_preservation.deduplication: Preserved SHA-256 contentHash normalization and duplicate URL checking
caching_deduplication_preservation.timeout_retry: Existing exponential backoff and timeout handling preserved

empty_state.clean_message: No relevant disaster news available right now.
empty_state.ui_behavior: When zero disaster articles remain after filtering, displays dedicated alert icon and message without falling back to unrelated general news.

limitations: Articles with ambiguous single-word headings lacking summary context will default to OTHER_DISASTER if disaster keywords are present, or be excluded if non-disaster.
Offline/disconnected mode relies on stored MongoDB disaster items and built-in official disaster bulletins.
